caseName: McDougall v. Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Rosanna McDougall, Administratrix, etc. v. Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Company

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas denied. Mr. L. W. Keplinger for petitioner. No appearance for respondent.
